a01_f00e: Good morning, Commander.
We have successfully begun implementing
the President's emergency Lazarus plan.
I am Lieutenant Eva,
the intelligence officer assigned to your command.
Since you are the only commander left,
I suppose I am lucky to have a new assignment.
It appears we are facing a full-scale Soviet invasion.
Almost every major city is under attack,
and our forces are in disarray.
One moment, Commander.
We have a message from General Carville at the Pentagon.
Commander, I hope you are rested and ready.
As of 0800 hours, you command every satellite on the East Coast,
every base, tank, aircraft, and every enlisted man, woman and child.
You report directly to the President and me.
This lieutenant will be your indispensable operations officer.
Special Agent Tanya will lead reconnaissance for this mission.
General, I hope the Commander can make quick decisions,
because we do not have much time to waste.
I am sure Tanya has complete confidence in you, Commander.
You sound very sure of that.
After all, you are not the one risking your life out there!
She is the best,
but you will have to learn how to deal with the Soviets.
You leave immediately. First stop: New York.
The lieutenant will brief you on the details.
A short time ago, Soviet amphibious forces landed on
Manhattan Island. Their ground forces are systematically
occupying the city.
Fortunately, we are still holding Fort Bradley,
but communications have been cut.
If you can get Agent Tanya into Fort Bradley,
she can restore communications.
Good luck, Commander.
a01_p02e: Excellent, Commander. We have reestablished contact with the fort.
Tanya has sent us the location of a major Soviet supply depot.
General Carville wants you to deal with it immediately.
And, sir, keep up the excellent work.
a01_p03e: Listen carefully. We have found some Dreadnoughts in the harbor
that were planning a sightseeing trip up the Hudson.
I plan to give them a different view from underwater first.

You may continue to mourn your past,
